0.0: #b#h0##k, you did the impossible. Black Heaven and Gelimer have both fallen because of you. #h0#, you led our efforts in defending Maple World and are worthy to take on the title of #bHeart of the Alliance#k. Do you accept this title?

no.0: I see. If you don't like the title, then I will not force it on you.

yes.0: Thank you. The Alliance shall never fear the darkness as long as we have you.
